reconciliation.note: 14 clean pet-friendly and 14 clean verified-no-pets over a 91-identity census. A row publishes only on an OPERATIVE first-party quote from the property's own page, bound to its census identity by the street identity that page states: a fee, a weight, a count, an amenity chip or a service-animal sentence alone publishes nothing. 63 reads were made and did not publish (5 AWAITING_CONTRADICTION_RESOLUTION; 26 AWAITING_OFFICIAL_URL; 19 AWAITING_POLICY_OBSERVATION; 13 AWAITING_ROUTING_REVIEW); every one is named in augusta_ga_final_partition_007.json with its exact class -- AWAITING_OFFICIAL_URL, AWAITING_POLICY_OBSERVATION, AWAITING_ROUTING_REVIEW (includes the Hilton capability wall) and AWAITING_CONTRADICTION_RESOLUTION (a plain-reading refusal the shared first-party reader would not mechanically confirm -- held, never guessed). No gate was lowered to preserve a count.

derived_globals.why: the committed globals are byte-identical to a regeneration from the shards and no other market's shard changed, so their diff is exactly augusta-ga's contribution
